Scope: skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json + packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-write-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts, skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md. Cited code read on `origin/main` at `f18adce2`; inputs: card #30229 (body and every comment), PR #30439 (body, file list, net diff), and the head's check-runs. Judged on the tree, not on the PR body's account of it.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Served-type list, six to twelve — right.** `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` carries thirteen `overridable` rows; `isOpenOverrideType` admits a row with no D9 conditions or one named in `CONDITIONS_DELIVERED` (= `flow`), so `action` is classified overridable and refused at the door as `declared_type_not_yet_available`. The twelve are served by three paths on `main`: view, dashboard, report, translation and email_template (`allowEnvironmentOverlay: true`) through `findServedOverlayRow`'s `servedOverride` candidate and `isServedOverrideRowOf`; `flow` through `declinesStoredRow`'s first branch; page, app, dataset, doc, book and mapping through `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` in its last branch. No served type is missing: an `action` row is declined (`isUnservedSealedOverlay` true, `servesSealedOverrideRow` false), a permission set is the security catalog's own channel (`isServedOverrideRowOf` is false for it, and the next paragraph already says never overridden), an object is `extend_only`. Naming the list rather than `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is the right call: that symbol would promise `action`.
- **The revert sentence — right.** `isPairRowRemoval(type, owner, packageId)` admits a removal naming the base's pair for every open type; `deleteMetaItem` then skips `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, deletes with `intent: 'runtime-only'`, and `restoreArtifactRegistryView` lifts the shadow, so the code package's item is what the reads serve. Pinned for a view at `protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts:767` (the read serves the base again; its rollback stays refused). A removal naming no package, the base, or another package keeps its refusal, so "naming the pair" is the right instruction.
- **The DELETE URL — real route, real spelling.** `DELETE ${metaPath}/:type/:name` (`meta-item-write-routes.ts:380`), `metaPath` = `/api` + `/v1` + `/meta` by the spec defaults; `package` is in the closed set `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS` and read by `metaItemPackageBinding(req.query.package)`; singular `view` is the canonical type spelling. The eval's `DELETE /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account_grid?package=hotcrm.custom` is that route.
- **The two clauses deleted to pay the ratchet — each rule survives.** "and ignores any other package's declaration": the read rule stays in the same sentence ("honours it only from the pair (the row's `package_id`)"), and the write rule at line 130 ("Only the pair declares: the save, publish and install doors, `os validate` and `os build` refuse `overrides` from any other package"); eval 10's reference answer still says "no declaration from any other package (ignored)". ", never by a base-named or package-less read": "served only under its own `?package=`" in the same clause is that rule stated with "only". Nothing a customer agent loads lost either rule.
- **Public surface.** No runtime code moves; what publishes is `@objectstack/skills` (`dist/skills` is a byte copy of `skills/**`), so the changeset's target is right.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, both in the changeset body and in the PR body — matches the diff: prose plus an eval fixture; no authorable key, value or type moves; nothing narrows. `skip-changeset` would have been wrong (the diff ships in a released package). `gen:skill-docs` reads frontmatter only (`build-skill-docs.ts`), so a body change owes no generated artifact. The declaration line reads `no`, no arm — right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Four derived gates NOT MEASURED locally (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`): answered by the head's check-runs — every `Lint · …` and `Type Check · …` job concluded `success`.
- `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 on the unbuilt worktree: a local-only family, says nothing about the diff. Answered.
- Model-free commit trailers: the form AGENTS.md asks for. Answered.
- No PR labels sent; `documentation`, `size/s` and `tooling` are the labeler's. Answered.
- `open_questions`: none.
- Observation (the `must_contain` oracle scans `ui/skills` only): re-done by hand — every `must_contain` token of cases 13 and 14 is a whole token of `SKILL.md` at the head (`hotcrm.custom`, `overrides:`, `dataset`, `page`, `DELETE`, `?package=hotcrm.custom`). Answered; nothing to escalate.
- Observation (`OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` names `action`): the door is the authority for what a customer may do, and the skill follows the door. Answered; nothing to escalate.
- Token ratchet 6009 of 6011: in the `Lint · repo & tooling gates` job, `success`.
- Check-runs as read at 2026-11-05T11:42Z: 26 `success`, 13 `skipped`, `Test Core (1/8)` still `in_progress` — a test shard a prose-and-fixture diff cannot move; its conclusion stays the gate's.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`** — against the card's eval prompts and the code on `main`: holds. The paragraph now says what the reads do (twelve types, none the door refuses), the revert ADR-0146 names, and the one instruction that makes the revert work (name the pair). Tried to break it: an `email_template` override is one row per (name, locale), so its removal names the member too — the ellipsis in `DELETE …?package=hotcrm.custom` covers the selector and the sentence before it already teaches the per-locale identity; the pair's own `?package=hotcrm.custom` read is not claimed to serve the base; the D11 and dependent-locale sentences are untouched. No finding.
- Note, not a finding: the bundle never spells the meta item path (`/api/v1/meta/:type/:name` is taught by `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:69`), so the `…` leans on the sibling bundle; at headroom 2 that is the right trade.

**`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`** — cases 13 and 14 exercise exactly what acceptance 2 asks (a dataset-and-page override; a removal); their `must_contain` tokens are taught; neither reference answer spells one of its own `must_not_contain` strings; the route tokens follow the file's own convention (case 10).
- **should-fix** — case 13's `must_not_contain` carries `only for views`, a substring of its own prompt ("…or is that only for views?"). The natural correct opening — "No, not only for views" — is graded as a failure. It is the only one of the fourteen cases whose prompt contains one of its own forbidden strings. Fix in place: drop the token (the `dataset` and `page` `must_contain` already catch a views-only answer), or re-spell the prompt so the phrase is not the answer's echo.
- Note, not a finding: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/crm_pipeline` also matches a pair-named save (`…?package=hotcrm.custom`), which `saveMetaItem` admits; the bundle teaches the override as a package-authored declaration and never through the item door, and case 10 set the same convention, so it stands.

No must-fix.
